title: SNDL & 1CM Provide Update Regarding Arrangement
summary: EDMONTON, Alberta and TORONTO, Dec. 15, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - SNDL Inc. (Nasdaq: SNDL, CSE: SNDL) (“ SNDL ”) and 1CM Inc. (CSE: EPIC) (OTCQB: MILFF) (FSE: IQ70) (“ 1CM ”) announce that they have entered into an amended and restated arrangement agreement (the “ AR Arrangement Agreement ”) dated December 15, 2025. The AR Arrangement Agreement amends and restates the arrangement agreement dated April 9, 2025 between 1CM and SNDL (the “ Original Arrangement Agreement ”), pursuant to which SNDL agreed to, among other things, acquire 32 cannabis retail stores operating under the Cost Cannabis and T Cannabis banners in Ontario, Alberta and Saskatchewan (the “ Transaction ”) for a purchase price of $32.2 million in cash, subject to certain adjustments. Under the AR Arrangement Agreement, the parties have agreed to, among other things, complete the Transaction in two stages to align with the status of required provincial regulatory approvals.
